QUOTE: "`tokenize` returns an empty `std::vector<int32_t>`. It does this in three cases: the vocab pointer is null (silent), the fill call returns negative (logged at error level, with only the text length), or no tokenizer is wired (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:795`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the empty vector is returned both for a failed fill and for no tokenizer wired, so failure and the unwired case give the same value.
